html:
G'oya

"Hamma kategoriyadan olgan" ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozib bo'lmaydi, lekin uni teskari aytish mumkin: bu mijoz hali olmagan kategoriya yo'q. Bu ikki karra NOT EXISTS bo'ladi. Tashqisi kategoriyalarni ko'rib chiqadi, ichkisi shu kategoriyadan mijozning xaridi bormi deb tekshiradi.

Yechim

SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM products p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM purchases pu
    JOIN products p2 ON p2.id = pu.product_id
    WHERE pu.customer_id = c.id
      AND p2.category = p.category
  )
)

Eng ichki so'rovda purchases mahsulotlar bilan ulanadi, chunki xaridda kategoriya yo'q, faqat product_id bor. U yerda c.id eng tashqi so'rovdan keladi ("shu mijoz"), p.category esa o'rtadagisidan ("shu kategoriya"). Hech narsa olmagan mijoz uchun birinchi kategoriyaning o'zi "olinmagan" chiqadi va u natijaga kirmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Xaridlarni sanash. Namunada Dilnoza ikki marta xarid qilgan, kategoriyalar ham ikkita, lekin non ham, sut ham oziq-ovqat. COUNT(*) uni hamma kategoriyadan olgan deb hisoblaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN purchases pu ON pu.customer_id = c.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = pu.product_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) FROM products)

Bir mahsulotni uch marta olish ham bitta kategoriya. Sanash kerak bo'lsa, kategoriyalarni takrorsiz sanang.

Boshqa yo'l

Mijoz olgan kategoriyalar sonini jami kategoriyalar soni bilan solishtirish. Ko'pchilik uchun bu o'qishga osonroq:

SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN purchases pu ON pu.customer_id = c.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = pu.product_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) FROM products)
